descriptions.networkRx: Volume of incoming network data. Helps identify download spikes and inbound system load.
descriptions.networkTx: Volume of outgoing network data. Helps identify upload spikes and outbound system load.
descriptions.networkErrors: Hardware or link-level packet errors. Spikes indicate faulty interfaces, bad cables, or driver issues.
descriptions.tcpIpStack: Rate of new TCP connections. Active Opens = outbound (we connect to others). Passive Opens = inbound (others connect to us).
descriptions.tcpRetransmits: Deep eBPF kernel tracing of lost packets. High rates strongly indicate network congestion or packet drops.
descriptions.socketStates: Real-time usage of network sockets. Helps monitor connection limits and prevent resource exhaustion.
